TZA.note: Nothing on an ID authentication service.

facts.fact: INEC says its Biometric Voter Registration kits, in use since 2019/2020, are being upgraded to an Android model for the March 2025 register update, with 3,427,917 voters registered in Dar es Salaam.
INEC says the new BVR kit has been upgraded to integrate with the NIDA database, and matches fingerprints against existing records to detect double registration.

TZA.note: No national ID enrolment figure; voter counts are not ID coverage.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs or owns the ID system.
Only an electoral kit integrating with NIDA; no register keyed on the ID number stated.
Fingerprint matching described is for the voter register, not the national ID system.
